title: Three Months and One Short Stamp
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：violence　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 violence 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1983 the clerk ① reported the violence that no applicant in the office would have recorded, and he said the reporting was the whole of the month. The ② violence, meaning the force itself and not the stamp, ran three months and stayed unrecorded in the book; violence, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ sort of violence in that office had the same short stamp beside it, and the ④ violence at the far counter, meaning the form they kept for the children to sign and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Violence, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the clerk said the recording is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the violence was the whole of the matter, meaning the harm and not the force. The ⑥ violence, meaning the harm and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; violence, he said, is either something you report or the only word that means both force and a harm. He said the harm is the part they remember.

By 1988 the ⑦ violence had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short stamp. The ⑧ violence of the whole thing, the clerk wrote in May, was one office and three months of recording; violence, he said, is either the form at the far counter or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ violence I remember is the violence recorded in the file, which closed in 1990 and is still recorded as the quietest in the office. ⑩ Violence, my mother said in 1992, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all violence, she said, is a harm that has agreed to look like force. She said the harm was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 暴力（指办事处里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 暴力（指那起暴力本身，与小小的印章相对）
C. 固定搭配：report the violence 举报这一起暴力
D. n. 暴力（指留给孩子们签的那一份）
E. n. 暴力之事（抽象总称，指一处办事处的暴力之事）
F. n. 暴力（指卷宗里写到、被记载的那一起）
G. n. 暴力、祸害（指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 祸害（抽象总称，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: reported the violence that no applicant in the office would have recorded

answers.why: report the violence 意为“举报这一起暴力”，1983 年那位书记员把办事处里没有一位申请人肯记载的一起暴力做了一遍。
violence 意为“暴力”，指那起暴力本身而不是小小的印章，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记载。
violence 意为“暴力”，指办事处里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一枚小小的印章。
violence 意为“暴力”，指最远那个窗口的留给孩子们签的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
violence 意为“暴力、祸害”，指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这起祸害就是那件事的全部。
violence 意为“祸害”，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西而不是那起暴力，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
violence 意为“暴力”，指卷宗里写到、被记载的那一起，到 1988 年这一起成了卷宗里的一行。
violence 意为“暴力之事”，书记员五月写道，整件事的暴力之事是一处办事处和三个月份的记载。
violence 意为“暴力”，我记得的是卷宗里记载过的那一起，1990 年办结了，至今仍被说成办事处里最安静的一起。
violence 为抽象总称，母亲 1992 年说，暴力是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的暴力。
